message.content:
**Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)**  
*Address:* 1 Seacore Drive, Miami, FL 33132  
*Phone:* +1 305‑555‑1234 (Amtrak Customer Service)  
*Website:* https://www.amtrak.com/stations/mia  

### Why it’s pet‑friendly
- **Amtrak’s pet policy** allows small dogs (≤ 20 lb) in carriers on all Amtrak trains, including the Silver Meteor and Silver Star that stop here. Larger pets can travel as checked baggage on certain routes, subject to availability and fees.  
- The station itself is fully ADA‑accessible and offers a dedicated “Pet Relief Area” near the entrance, making it easier to manage your pet while you wait for your train.  
- There are no additional pet‑related charges at the station—just the standard Amtrak pet fee (currently $25 for a carrier, plus a $10 surcharge for larger pets if applicable).

### Quick reference
| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Train services** | Amtrak Silver Meteor & Silver Star |
| **Pet allowance** | Small dogs in carriers (≤ 20 lb) free of charge; larger pets require a $25 carrier fee + $10 surcharge |
| **Station amenities** | Pet relief area, wheelchair ramps, elevators, restrooms, ticket kiosks |
| **Contact** | +1 305‑555‑1234 (for pet‑policy questions) |

If you’re planning a trip with a pet, it’s a good idea to call Amtrak ahead of time to confirm the pet fee and any special arrangements needed for your specific route. Happy travels!
